reason: ADR-070.4 (owner decision): per-account fake-star filtering (StarScout-style) no longer works for repos the operator does not own; it is retired and replaced by aggregate anomaly checks on daily star counts against forks, issues, downloads and external mentions. Star metrics are labelled 'unfiltered, anomaly-checked' (PRD R3.3). The burst block is unchanged. M21b.
implementation: src/pigtail/analysis/params.py mirrors this file (a test keeps them equal); src/pigtail/analysis/bursts.py applies the burst block; src/pigtail/analysis/anomaly.py applies the anomaly_check block.
change_rule: Any change is a new version of this file and of PARAMS_VERSION, logged in ops/DECISIONS.md; for a brief, the version in force is fixed before its outcome sort (outcome model v2 §5.8).

burst.series: raw star-history daily net counts n(d), endpoint days (ADR-032.3)
